title: 13 DPWH-Soccsksargen execs, private individuals face graft, malversation cases over ‘road right of way scam’

blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman filed graft and malversation charges against six Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH)-Soccsksargen officials and seven private individuals on Tuesday over an alleged scam on the road right of way in General Santos City amounting to P491 million.
